title: Zayn audit facts, version 1.2 (reads 1.1, then called zane-audit-facts, and 1.0, then called zui-audit-facts)
description: What a writer must measure from ONE screenshot so that the audit can judge the rules a screenshot can decide (doc/design/AUDIT-FACTS.md). The writer measures; it never judges. Every derived field is recomputable from the others and doc/design/audit/check-facts.js proves it. A field the writer could not measure is null, never a guess and never zero.

format.description: zayn-audit-facts with version 1.2; zane-audit-facts and zui-audit-facts, the former names, with versions 1.1 and 1.0. The three differ in their name only.

image.description: The screenshot path the caller gave, as given.

image_sha256.description: Optional. Lets a later reader prove the facts belong to this exact image.

scale.description: Device pixels per CSS pixel, supplied by the CALLER (2 on a typical high-density display). The writer cannot measure it from pixels, so it must not guess it.

box_kind.description: What each box encloses. 'line': the whole line box, at least as tall as the font's em. 'ink': a tight box around the drawn glyphs, which can be about half an em for a line with no ascender or descender. The size verdict needs 'line' (see AUDIT-FACTS.md section 4).

method.description: How foreground and background were separated inside a box, in the writer's words (for example 'crop, grayscale, Otsu split, median of each side'). Recorded so a ratio can be argued with.

id.description: Stable within the file; the audit's findings cite it.

score.description: The OCR engine's confidence in the text.

box.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in image pixels, x1 > x0 and y1 > y0, inside the image.

line_height_pt.description: line_height_px x 72 / (96 x scale), rounded to 2 decimals. A line box, so an UPPER BOUND on the font size when box_kind is 'line'.

fg_luminance.description: WCAG relative luminance of the text colour, 0 (black) to 1 (white).

bg_luminance.description: WCAG relative luminance of the colour behind the text.

contrast_ratio.description: (max + 0.05) / (min + 0.05) of the two luminances, rounded to 2 decimals. null when either luminance is null.

bg_spread.description: OPTIONAL. The range of luminance seen in the background pixels of the box (the writer built for this schema takes the 2nd to the 98th percentile over background pixels 3 px or more from ink). Large means text over a gradient or an image, where one background luminance is a fiction. The audit judges contrast at the worst end of it: bg_luminance moved by bg_spread toward the text colour. null or absent means the writer did not measure it, and the audit then says the contrast is an estimate it cannot vouch for.
